whoActs.DRAFT: Ops Admin completes the intake, then submits it.
whoActs.ITINERARY_SUBMITTED: Ops Admin starts dispatch from the dashboard's tasks.
whoActs.DISPATCH_IN_PROGRESS: Workers accept or decline each offer. The desk watches the matrix and calls at amber.

whoActs.PENDING_PAYMENT: The traveler pays by bank transfer; the desk confirms the receipt.
whoActs.ACTION_REQUIRED: Ops Admin re-dispatches from the dashboard, or offers the traveler an alternative.
whoActs.CONFIRMED: System: voucher, work orders and invoice.
whoActs.IN_PROGRESS: Desk: incidents and duty of care.
whoActs.COMPLETED: System: review prompt and the retention clock.
whoActs.CANCELLED: Ops Admin applies the cancellation policy.

severityRules.MINOR: Inconvenience, itinerary holds. Desk handles; travelers contacted once.
severityRules.MAJOR: Services lost or relocation needed. Super Admin informed; 4-hourly contact.
severityRules.EMERGENCY: Safety at risk. Crisis team paged, hourly contact, critical banner, insurer notified.

paths.MINOR: Desk owns it. Super Admin sees it in the daily digest. Travelers contacted once with options; no public banner unless it affects arrivals.
paths.MAJOR: Desk owns it, Super Admin informed within 1 h and approves the public banner. Travelers contacted every 4 h until resolved. Incident logged for the MINTUR annual summary.
paths.EMERGENCY: Crisis team paged (Super Admin, Operations Director, local coordinator). Hourly traveler contact, critical banner with two approvals, 24/7 line staffed in shifts.
